## Use Case

What problem does this feature solve? Who benefits and how?

## Proposed Solution

A clear and concise description of what you'd like to happen.

## Alternatives Considered

Alternative approaches you've thought about and why they were rejected.

## Compliance Considerations

- [ ] Preserves PRISMA 2020 compliance
- [ ] Preserves human-in-the-loop design (humans retain final decision authority)
- [ ] Compatible with RAIES guidelines
- [ ] Compatible with DEST framework
- [ ] Maintains reproducibility (deterministic given identical inputs)

## Implementation Sketch (optional)

If you have ideas about how to implement this, share them here.

## Additional Context

Screenshots, references, related issues, or links to relevant literature.
